method: Unmodified standard viewer global Terrarium field; bilinear interpolation at pixel centers in the signed bridge frame. No flattening or terrain fitting. The 6m review sampling oversamples the coarse underlying DEM.
attribution: Mapzen/Terrain Tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
limitations: Coarse mixed-source field, not surveyed terrain, with bridge/building/vegetation returns possible. Endpoint/foundation attachment is approximate.
